properties.summary: Illustrative massing: the approved 130-ft podium over the whole lot and a 520-ft tower set out from the dimensions on the 2020 plan set (12 ft from Van Ness Avenue, 55 ft 7 in from Fell Street, 141 ft long, 13,200 sq ft). The 2024 and 2025 approvals kept the same envelope. The tower's faceted plan and sloped top are not drawn; construction stopped at the excavation and foundations.
properties.note: The approved podium and tower as simple volumes, not the final design.

georeference.method: Plan dimensions laid out from the Van Ness Avenue / Fell Street corner of the DataSF parcel, along its two frontages.

properties.license: Dimensions: from a public SF Planning document. Lot: DataSF parcels (ODC-PDDL).

properties.label: Podium
properties.use: Office, with shops and lobbies on the ground floor
properties.source: illustrative: the lot (DataSF parcel 0835/004) less the tower, at the 130-ft podium height in the Planning Commission packet, Record No. 2017-008051 (30 Van Ness Avenue), hearing May 21, 2020, draft Downtown Project Authorization, PDF p. 34
properties.note: A nine-story podium of about 253,000 gross sq ft of office (Motion 21700, 2025). The existing building's walls are kept as part of it.

properties.label: Tower
properties.source: illustrative: a 141 x 93.6 ft rectangle set out from the dimensions on the Planning Commission packet, Record No. 2017-008051 (30 Van Ness Avenue), hearing May 21, 2020, PDF p. 488 (typical residential floor plan L13-L15); roof height from the same packet (PDF p. 34) and Motion 21700 (2025)
properties.note: Roof up to 520 ft, 540 ft with rooftop screening and equipment (Motion 21700). The real floor plate is faceted, and the top five floors slope down toward Fell Street.
